It's our busy season-people are starting to book our tours for their vacations. W: There's still some money in the budget. We should use it to advertise our most recent package-a guided exploration of the theater district, including tickets to a performance. M: That's a good idea. Let me check how much it would cost to add that information to our current commercials.

W: Marcel, we've been getting some complaints from our guests when they check out. Some people think the parking garage fee is included in the room reservation. They don't know they have to pay when they exit. M: Oh. Well, it's written on the confirmation they receive. But I'll start reminding our guests at check-in as well. W: Great, thank you. Also, remember the landscaping crew is coming by next week to plant some spring flowers by the entrance of the lobby. It's starting to feel a bit warmer outside.

M: Polina, congratulations on being voted Nurse of the Year for our hospital. You really deserve the honor! W: Thanks! I'm a little embarrassed by all the attention, though. M: Well, you shouldn't be. After all, your patients and colleagues all felt you should be recognized for your outstanding efforts. Actually, I'm hoping you'll help me update the training materials for new nurses. W: I'd be happy to help! And by the way, will you be at the awards ceremony next week? All the hospital's winners will be celebrated. M: Of course! I'm looking forward to it.

M1: Hello. I'm looking for a book that's listed in your library's catalog, but I can't find it on the shelves. Could you help me? W: Sorry, I'm helping another patron on the phone right now. Let me get one of my coworkers for you. M2: Hi. How can I help you? M1: I'm looking for a book about abstract art called Night Canvases. M2: Oh! We just received several copies of that, but they're still packed in the box. If you come back tomorrow, they'll be ready to borrow.

M: Silvia, I just heard the city mayor will hold a press conference this afternoon. Can you cover it? I'll be at the opening of the new train station. W: OK, I'll get a camera crew together right away. I hope the mayor will provide details about the proposal to build an offshore wind farm. M: Yes, that's what I heard he'll discuss. There's a lot of interest in wind energy, so this will likely be the lead story on tonight's news. W: Perfect. I'm going to ask the mayor about funding for the project. The city residents will want to know where the finances will come from.

W: Koji, you weren't at the team meeting this morning. Is everything OK? M: I had to take my car to the mechanic for repairs. What did I miss? W: Well, we received some good news. Our firm is planning to hire more accountants! M: That's great! We've been busier than ever since we started working with True Valley Industries. W: Yes. By the way, there's an article on our Web site about the founder of True Valley. I'd suggest reading it. M: I'll be sure to check it out.

W1: Let's discuss the upcoming retreat for the architects at our firm. How's the planning going, Hongtai and Raya? M: Well, the Evans Nature Reserve said they can organize a two-day expedition for us. W2: Yes, they're even offering a wildlife photography workshop on the second day. I'm excited about that. W1: Oh, that is exciting! Do you know if we'll be able to camp in the reserve overnight? M: Yes, that's an option. But I don't know if all our staff have tents and camping equipment. I'm sure we can rent enough for everybody, though. Let me look into it.

M: Hi, Ms. Espinoza. This is Malik calling from ACC Internet Providers. I'm here at your residence at 88 Glassbury Avenue to set up your Internet. W: Oh! W: Klaus, you were on the research team that went to the Arctic last month, right? For the new project? M: Yes. I'll be going again next month. Are you joining? Welcome to another segment of Belmack City Business News. Belmack City has one of the biggest seaports in the country. The port receives and distributes thousands of containers full of cargo each day. Goods from the ships are usually distributed throughout the region by train or by truck. However, sometimes the goods need to wait for days before they are transported, which can cause problems due to lack of affordable storage space. Unfortunately, lease costs for storage space in the area are too high for many shipping companies to afford. After the break, we'll hear from Pablo Alvarez, owner of Alva Shipping, about this issue. So stay tuned!

Welcome. I'm delighted to be leading another outdoor workshop here in the botanical gardens. The paintings that participants produced last time were extraordinary-there's nothing like being surrounded by flowers to inspire creativity. Now, remember that your participation fee does include a light lunch. I see you've all found spots to set up your easels and you all have your own canvas and paints. That's perfect, since we don't provide painting supplies. Before we get started, let's take a moment to have everyone tell us their names and why they signed up.

Currently, you're all working on our design project for Takahashi Systems. They like the suggestions you've made so far, such as how to update their logo to make it more modern. That's welcome news because they have high standards. They mentioned they'll be in the area this Friday and expressed interest in visiting our office, so l've invited them. But as I was walking by the workstation area, I noticed a lot of clutter. Please remember that making a good impression is important.

Good morning, everyone. I appreciate you all getting here early before your assembly-line shift starts. I have a major announcement to make. Remember our new injection mold machine was acting up yesterday? A technician came at the end of the day, and it turns out the hydraulic safety switch is turning itself off randomly. A part needs to be replaced, but that won't happen until later this week. In the meantime, please use our older machine only, which, as you know, is not as fast as the new one. I'll need you to start working as soon as possible.

Hi, Mr. Rossi. I work at Cullom Studios, and I'm a production assistant for a new film that'll be set in seventeenth-century France. I'm calling because we'd like to hire you as a consultant for our film. I recently came across the book you wrote on the history of French fashion and found it fascinating. Since you're an expert on French clothing and lifestyle trends of that time, your knowledge would be valuable as we develop costume and set designs. We'd be thrilled to work with you, and we're offering a generous compensation package. I can send you the details-l'll use the e-mail address that you have on your Web site.

Are you looking for a convenient way to get around the city? The city of Lakepoint offers on-demand transportation in several of our neighborhoods. Just download the Lakepoint City application onto your mobile phone. Once you make an appointment on the app, a shuttle will arrive within fifteen minutes. This easy-to-use service will take you to any destination within the service area, like your doctor's office or the library! And we've recently expanded service to Westbrook, so residents can take the shuttle to the soccer stadium.

And our last news item today is the Greenchester Archaeological Festival taking place this weekend. Greenchester is home to some rich prehistoric findings. If you've ever wondered what goes into excavating a site, here's your chance to find out. There'll be a special workshop where you can get hands-on experience practicing excavation skills. The workshop will be held on the grounds in front of the historical society building. As for getting here, I recommend that you simply walk over-many streets will be blocked off for the festival, and it will take longer to drive.

Tin Prices May Improve

LONDON (12 September)—Prices for tin rose to a record high in August. International inventories are unusually low at this time, and problems with availability persist. The price increases are driven by reduced supply in countries that produce the metal, coupled with increasing worldwide demand for and manufacturing of electronics, whose components are joined together with tin compounds.

Chilean Smelting, Inc., a major producer, has invested in improved equipment and aims to increase production. As a result, tin traders predict some moderation in prices as supplies rise.

3-D printers are also getting faster. This is particularly relevant to small-batch production of board games. — [4] —. Be Green Aware in Misford

March 26—The village of Misford will celebrate its annual Green Awareness Week in April. This event is coordinated by the village's Green Earth Committee and is part of a long-term effort to keep Misford green and clean.

The activities will start on Sunday, April 1, with a cleanup of the Misford Stream trails. Two teams of volunteers will work on either side of the stream to pick up any rubbish and clear the paths of fallen branches.

On Monday, residents are encouraged to walk along the trails and take photographs. The Green Earth Committee is accepting digital images and will select the ten best to post to the village Web site.

On Tuesday and Wednesday, residents who come to the village hall can pick up cloth bags to replace single-use plastic shopping bags, the sale of which will be banned in our county starting next month.

On Thursday, the Misford Library will host a panel on ways to conserve energy and reduce and recycle waste. These are fundamental goals of the village and its Green Earth Committee. Children are welcome to attend with an adult.

Finally, on Saturday, 500 tree saplings will be offered to residents free of charge. The trees are native to the region and can be planted in private gardens or in some public areas.

Alamito Botanical Society

Submit your home garden to be one of several stops on this year's Gorgeous Gardens Tour, scheduled for July 3!

This year's tour theme is Winged Paradise, with a focus on flowering plants favored by regional birds and butterflies, including the lesser goldfinch and the ringlet butterfly. All proceeds from ticket sales for this year's tour will go toward replanting the cottonwood forest in Presidio County Park.

Hosting a tour garden is free for members of the Alamito Botanical Society. Simply complete the form at www.alamitobotanicalsociety.org/gorgeousgardens and submit it with digital photos of your garden by May 20. Gardens selected to participate in the tour must be within Presidio County and include only plants native to the region. If you have questions regarding participating as a tour stop, please send an e-mail to info@alamitobotanicalsociety.org.

*E-mail*

To: info@alamitobotanicalsociety.org

From: rebeccaolton@mailhost.com

Date: May 1

Subject: Question about garden tour

Hello,

I became a member of the Alamito Botanical Society last year shortly after moving to Presidio County. The society's Web site, resources, and educational lectures have been helpful regarding my ambitious project: to cover five acres of my land with various native plants that will attract birds and other animals. About one and a half acres of soil have been cultivated so far.

It would be a privilege to show my work to the public and to meet more people who value gardens as we members of the society do. Thus, I am writing to ask if I may participate in the Gorgeous Gardens Tour. I must admit that beautiful lavender bushes that are not native to the area were already growing on the property before I purchased it. However, lavender is not on the invasive-species list, and I continue to let them grow because the butterflies, bees, and other wildlife love the blooms.

Thank you,

Rebecca Olton

https://www.alamitobotanicalsociety.org/education/lectures

The leaders and members of the Alamito Botanical Society cordially invite the public to attend its educational lectures, held at the horticultural department of Marfa Community College. All lectures occur on the third Wednesday of the month at 7:00 P.M. Advance registration is not required.

February: Schedule Your Salad – Get tips for establishing a planting timetable and for selecting delicious vegetables to grow.

March: Nourish the Neighbors – Understand how to use plants native to our region to create landscapes that are inviting to wildlife.

April: Pest Deterrence – Learn natural, pesticide-free techniques that can prevent harmful insects from eating your fruits and vegetables.

May: Pollen Transportation – No butterflies or bees visiting your garden? No worries. Humans can pollinate certain plants using simple techniques.

Opportunity for Landowners

Terra Jaunts organizes nature hikes, farm stays, camping trips, athletic competitions, and other activities for company retreats. We are seeking farmers, ranchers, and other landowners who can help us expand our list of destinations. Terra Jaunts pays up to $300 per day to our partners for the daytime use of their property and provides all or most needed equipment.

Our required criteria are as follows.

The site is located within 100 kilometers of a medium to large city.
The site is able to host a retreat one or two days per month.
The site has adequate parking space for 50 cars or two buses.
The site can accommodate up to 75 people.

To:	Celia Newsom <cnewsom@pinkridgeranch.com>
From:	Oliver Jeong <ojeong@terrajaunts.com>
Date:	April 19
Subject:	Your application

Dear Ms. Newsom,

Thank you for applying to be a host. Even though you have less space for vehicles than we normally require, Pink Ridge Ranch might be suitable for our smaller events with fewer than 25 people. We appreciate your having created an illustrated list of all the native flowers and trees growing wild on your property; none of our other hosts offers anything like this. Your list of plants would be a real asset for groups engaged in activities involving the identification of species.

I would like to arrange a site visit with my associate Peter Cumberland either this week or next. After 1 P.M. on a Thursday or Friday would work best for us, but we will try to accommodate your schedule if you prefer a morning or a different day.

Sincerely,

Oliver Jeong
Montana Site Coordinator

*E-mail*

To:	Oliver Jeong <ojeong@terrajaunts.com>
From:	Celia Newsom <cnewsom@pinkridgeranch.com>
Date:	May 1
Subject:	RE: Your application

Dear Mr. Jeong:

Thank you for touring my ranch on Thursday. I am glad you were able to follow my complicated written directions for driving to and from the ranch after your GPS app stopped working. It was wonderful to meet you both and have a chance to show you around.

I received your follow-up voicemail yesterday. After further consideration, I have decided not to pursue this opportunity after all. The hiking paths on my property are quite overgrown, as your partner pointed out. Unfortunately, I do not have the time or staff to ensure that everything is properly groomed throughout the year. If this situation changes, I will reapply.

Kind regards,

Celia Newsom, Owner, Pink Ridge Ranch

77. - Dẫn chứng: "This is Anil Gupta from Jeremy's Family Restaurants calling about the application you sent in." (Đây là Anil Gupta từ Nhà hàng Gia đình Jeremy gọi về đơn xin việc mà bạn đã gửi.)
- Paraphrase: Jeremy's Family Restaurants (Nhà hàng Gia đình Jeremy) = Food service (Dịch vụ ăn uống).

questions.stem: According to the speaker, what would be useful?
questions.explanation:
78. - Dẫn chứng: "I understand the program included training in using bookkeeping software. That would be useful in our company." (Tôi hiểu rằng chương trình bao gồm đào tạo sử dụng phần mềm kế toán. Điều đó sẽ hữu ích trong công ty chúng ta.)
- Paraphrase: training in using bookkeeping software (đào tạo sử dụng phần mềm kế toán) = Knowledge of specialized software (Kiến thức về phần mềm chuyên dụng).

questions.stem: What does the speaker imply when he says, “I hope you haven't accepted any offers yet”?

options.text: He thinks the listener deserves a promotion.
He would like to hire the listener.
A company would not be good to work for.
A salary offer is too low.

questions.explanation:
79. - Dẫn chứng: "I hope you haven't accepted any offers yet!" (Tôi hy vọng bạn chưa chấp nhận bất kỳ lời đề nghị nào!)
- Paraphrase: I hope you haven't accepted any offers yet (Tôi hy vọng bạn chưa chấp nhận bất kỳ lời đề nghị nào) = He would like to hire the listener (Anh ấy muốn thuê người nghe).

questions.stem: What is the news segment about?

options.text: The construction of a new port

questions.explanation:
80. - Dẫn chứng: "The port receives and distributes thousands of containers full of cargo each day." (Cảng tiếp nhận và phân phối hàng nghìn container đầy hàng hóa mỗi ngày.)
- Paraphrase: distributes thousands of containers full of cargo (phân phối hàng nghìn container đầy hàng hóa) = The distribution of goods (Việc phân phối hàng hóa).

questions.stem: What problem does the speaker mention?

options.text: Trained workers are difficult to find.
There is a shortage of supplies.
Poor road conditions are causing delays.

questions.explanation:
81. - Dẫn chứng: "which can cause problems due to lack of affordable storage space." (điều này có thể gây ra vấn đề do thiếu không gian lưu trữ giá cả phải chăng.)
- Paraphrase: lack of affordable storage space (thiếu không gian lưu trữ giá cả phải chăng) = Storage space is not affordable (Không gian lưu trữ không phải là giá cả phải chăng).

questions.stem: Who is Pablo Alvarez?
questions.explanation:
82. - Dẫn chứng: "we'll hear from Pablo Alvarez, owner of Alva Shipping, about this issue." (chúng ta sẽ nghe từ Pablo Alvarez, chủ sở hữu của Công ty Vận chuyển Alva, về vấn đề này.)
- Paraphrase: owner of Alva Shipping (chủ sở hữu của Công ty Vận chuyển Alva) = A business owner (Một chủ doanh nghiệp).

questions.stem: What is the focus of the workshop?
questions.explanation:
83. - Dẫn chứng: "The paintings that participants produced last time were extraordinary..." (Những bức tranh mà những người tham gia đã tạo ra lần trước thật phi thường...)
- Paraphrase: The paintings (Những bức tranh) = Painting (Vẽ tranh).

questions.stem: What does the speaker say is included in a workshop fee?
questions.explanation:
84. - Dẫn chứng: "remember that your participation fee does include a light lunch." (hãy nhớ rằng phí tham gia của bạn bao gồm một bữa trưa nhẹ.)
- Paraphrase: a light lunch (một bữa trưa nhẹ) = A meal (Một bữa ăn).

questions.stem: What will most likely happen next?

options.text: The listeners will sign some forms.
The speaker will give a demonstration.
The speaker will lead a tour.

questions.explanation:
85. - Dẫn chứng: "let's take a moment to have everyone tell us their names and why they signed up." (chúng ta hãy dành một chút thời gian để mọi người nói cho chúng ta biết tên của họ và tại sao họ đăng ký.)
- Paraphrase: tell us their names and why they signed up (nói cho chúng ta biết tên của họ và tại sao họ đăng ký) = introduce themselves (tự giới thiệu).

questions.stem: What service does the company provide?
questions.explanation:
86. - Dẫn chứng: "you're all working on our design project for Takahashi Systems." (tất cả các bạn đang làm việc trong dự án thiết kế của chúng ta cho Takahashi Systems.)
- Paraphrase: design project (dự án thiết kế) = Graphic design (Thiết kế đồ họa).

questions.stem: What does the speaker say about Friday?
questions.explanation:
87. - Dẫn chứng: "They mentioned they'll be in the area this Friday and expressed interest in visiting our office, so I've invited them." (Họ đề cập rằng họ sẽ ở khu vực này vào thứ Sáu tuần này và bày tỏ sự quan tâm đến việc thăm văn phòng của chúng ta, vì vậy tôi đã mời họ.)
- Paraphrase: visiting our office (thăm văn phòng của chúng ta) = A client will visit (Một khách hàng sẽ đến thăm).

questions.stem: What does the speaker imply when she says, “making a good impression is important”?

options.text: She will be providing her business card.
She does not want employees to be late.
She expects workstations to be clean.
She is unsatisfied with some potential job candidates.

questions.explanation:
88. - Dẫn chứng: "as I was walking by the workstation area, I noticed a lot of clutter. Please remember that making a good impression is important." (khi tôi đi ngang qua khu vực làm việc, tôi nhận thấy có rất nhiều đồ đạc bừa bộn. Xin hãy nhớ rằng việc tạo ấn tượng tốt là quan trọng.)
- Paraphrase: noticed a lot of clutter (nhận thấy có rất nhiều đồ đạc bừa bộn) = She expects workstations to be clean (Cô ấy mong đợi khu vực làm việc được sạch sẽ).

questions.stem: Where do the listeners most likely work?
questions.explanation:
89. - Dẫn chứng: "I appreciate you all getting here early before your assembly-line shift starts." (Tôi đánh giá cao việc tất cả các bạn đến sớm trước khi ca làm việc trên dây chuyền lắp ráp bắt đầu.)
- Paraphrase: assembly-line shift (ca làm việc trên dây chuyền lắp ráp) = At a factory (Tại một nhà máy).

questions.stem: Who visited the business yesterday?
questions.explanation:
90. - Dẫn chứng: "A technician came at the end of the day, and it turns out the hydraulic safety switch is turning itself off randomly." (Một kỹ thuật viên đã đến vào cuối ngày, và hóa ra công tắc an toàn thủy lực đang tự động tắt ngẫu nhiên.)
- Paraphrase: A technician came (Một kỹ thuật viên đã đến) = A repair person (Một người sửa chữa).

questions.stem: Why are the listeners asked to start working right away?

options.text: A task will take longer than usual.
An inspection will be conducted in the afternoon.

questions.explanation:
91. - Dẫn chứng: "please use our older machine only, which, as you know, is not as fast as the new one." (vui lòng chỉ sử dụng máy cũ hơn của chúng ta, mà như bạn biết đấy, nó không nhanh bằng máy mới.)
- Paraphrase: not as fast as the new one (không nhanh bằng máy mới) = A task will take longer than usual (Một nhiệm vụ sẽ mất nhiều thời gian hơn bình thường).

questions.stem: Why is the speaker calling?

options.text: To ask the listener to donate to a charity
To offer the listener a job
To request an interview for an article

questions.explanation:
92. - Dẫn chứng: "I'm calling because we'd like to hire you as a consultant for our film." (Tôi gọi điện vì chúng tôi muốn thuê bạn làm cố vấn cho bộ phim của chúng tôi.)
- Paraphrase: hire you as a consultant (thuê bạn làm cố vấn) = To offer the listener a job (Để đề nghị người nghe một công việc).

questions.stem: How did the speaker first learn about the listener?

options.text: She read one of his books.
She attended a workshop he led.
She saw his comment on a social media post.
She watched a documentary about his work.

questions.explanation:
93. - Dẫn chứng: "I recently came across the book you wrote on the history of French fashion and found it fascinating." (Gần đây tôi tình cờ thấy cuốn sách bạn viết về lịch sử thời trang Pháp và thấy nó hấp dẫn.)
- Paraphrase: came across the book you wrote (tình cờ thấy cuốn sách bạn viết) = She read one of his books (Cô ấy đã đọc một trong những cuốn sách của anh ấy).

questions.stem: What will the speaker most likely do next?
questions.explanation:
94. - Dẫn chứng: "I can send you the details-I'll use the e-mail address that you have on your Web site." (Tôi có thể gửi cho bạn thông tin chi tiết – tôi sẽ sử dụng địa chỉ e-mail bạn có trên trang web của mình.)
- Paraphrase: send you the details (gửi cho bạn thông tin chi tiết) = Send some information (Gửi một số thông tin).

questions.stem: What type of service is being advertised?
questions.explanation:
95. - Dẫn chứng: "The city of Lakepoint offers on-demand transportation in several of our neighborhoods." (Thành phố Lakepoint cung cấp dịch vụ vận chuyển theo yêu cầu ở một số khu phố của chúng ta.)
- Paraphrase: on-demand transportation (dịch vụ vận chuyển theo yêu cầu) = Transportation (Giao thông vận tải).

questions.stem: According to the speaker, how can the listeners use a new service?
questions.explanation:
96. - Dẫn chứng: "Just download the Lakepoint City application onto your mobile phone." (Chỉ cần tải xuống ứng dụng Thành phố Lakepoint vào điện thoại di động của bạn.)
- Paraphrase: download the Lakepoint City application onto your mobile phone (tải xuống ứng dụng Thành phố Lakepoint vào điện thoại di động của bạn) = By using a mobile application (Bằng cách sử dụng ứng dụng di động).

questions.stem: Look at the graphic. Which area was recently added?
questions.explanation:
97. - Dẫn chứng: "we've recently expanded service to Westbrook, so residents can take the shuttle to the soccer stadium." (chúng ta gần đây đã mở rộng dịch vụ đến Westbrook, vì vậy cư dân có thể đi xe buýt đưa đón đến sân vận động bóng đá.)
- Paraphrase: expanded service to Westbrook (mở rộng dịch vụ đến Westbrook). Nhìn vào bản đồ, sân vận động bóng đá nằm ở Area 2.

questions.stem: What event is the speaker mainly discussing?
questions.explanation:
98. - Dẫn chứng: "our last news item today is the Greenchester Archaeological Festival taking place this weekend." (tin tức cuối cùng của chúng ta hôm nay là Lễ hội Khảo cổ Greenchester diễn ra vào cuối tuần này.)
- Paraphrase: Archaeological Festival (Lễ hội Khảo cổ) = An archaeology festival (Một lễ hội khảo cổ).

questions.stem: Look at the graphic. Where will a workshop take place?
questions.explanation:
99. - Dẫn chứng: "The workshop will be held on the grounds in front of the historical society building." (Hội thảo sẽ được tổ chức trên khu đất phía trước tòa nhà hội lịch sử.)
- Paraphrase: the grounds in front of the historical society building (khu đất phía trước tòa nhà hội lịch sử). Nhìn vào bản đồ, khu đất phía trước Historical Society là Tanry Park.

questions.stem: What does the speaker recommend?
questions.explanation:
100. - Dẫn chứng: "I recommend that you simply walk over-many streets will be blocked off for the festival, and it will take longer to drive." (Tôi khuyên bạn nên đi bộ – nhiều con phố sẽ bị chặn cho lễ hội, và việc lái xe sẽ mất nhiều thời gian hơn.)
- Paraphrase: simply walk over (chỉ cần đi bộ) = Walking (Đi bộ).

questions.stem: On Saturday, the Edbridge Orchestra will ------- a new work by local composer Nina Borstein.
questions.explanation: Trong ngữ cảnh âm nhạc, động từ perform (trình diễn) là lựa chọn chính xác nhất để nói về việc một dàn nhạc chơi một tác phẩm mới.

questions.stem: It is important to be especially ------- when in the company of new clients.
questions.explanation: Sau động từ to be is và trạng từ chỉ mức độ especially, chúng ta cần một tính từ để mô tả tính chất. Polite (lịch sự) là lựa chọn phù hợp.

questions.stem: Although Ms. Endou was not chosen for an award, ------- achievements were praised.
questions.explanation: Chỗ trống đứng trước danh từ achievements, vì vậy ta cần một tính từ sở hữu. Her dùng để chỉ những thành tựu của cô Endou.

questions.stem: At the end of the year, organizations face pressure to achieve their financial -------.
questions.explanation: Cụm từ financial goals (mục tiêu tài chính) là một thuật ngữ phổ biến trong kinh doanh, chỉ những đích đến về tiền bạc mà tổ chức cần đạt được.

questions.stem: Online ordering is ------- on Naito Café's Web site.
questions.explanation: Tính từ available (có sẵn) được dùng để chỉ một dịch vụ (đặt hàng trực tuyến) có thể sử dụng được trên một nền tảng nào đó.

questions.stem: Mayor Park plans to meet with his campaign staff ------- the televised debate.
questions.explanation: Giới từ following (sau khi) chỉ mốc thời gian diễn ra cuộc gặp gỡ: sau khi buổi tranh luận trên truyền hình kết thúc.

questions.stem: Mr. Suh has requested that a more ------- copy machine be purchased for the finance department.
questions.explanation: Chỗ trống đứng trước cụm danh từ copy machine, cần một tính từ để bổ nghĩa. Reliable (đáng tin cậy/bền) là tính từ phù hợp.

questions.stem: Mr. Aponte's photograph of the autumn foliage will be featured on the front ------- of Outward Expansion Magazine.
questions.explanation: Cụm từ front cover (trang bìa trước) là thuật ngữ dùng để chỉ trang đầu tiên của một cuốn tạp chí.

questions.stem: Handi Office Supplies' new desk organizers serve ------- practical and stylish additions to any office workstation.
questions.explanation: Cấu trúc serve as (đóng vai trò là) dùng để mô tả chức năng hoặc công dụng của một vật phẩm.

questions.stem: The efficient redesign of the airline terminal led to ------- flight delays.
questions.explanation: Dựa vào ngữ cảnh "thiết kế lại hiệu quả" (efficient redesign), kết quả hợp lý nhất là dẫn đến fewer (ít hơn) những lần trì hoãn chuyến bay.

questions.stem: Mr. Ogbu's editor appreciated his ability to approach the subject matter -------.
questions.explanation: Chỗ trống đứng sau danh từ subject matter (nội dung/chủ đề) và bổ nghĩa cho động từ approach, vì vậy ta cần một trạng từ (objectively - một cách khách quan).

questions.stem: Mr. Nakayama was named Employee of the Year, ------- being new to the company.
questions.explanation: Despite (Mặc dù) là giới từ dùng để chỉ sự nhượng bộ, đứng trước cụm danh từ/V-ing để chỉ sự tương phản (mới vào công ty nhưng vẫn đạt giải nhân viên của năm).

questions.stem: For the ------- selection of premium paints and art-making supplies anywhere, visit your nearest Painters' Best store.
questions.explanation: Chỗ trống đứng sau mạo từ the và trước danh từ selection, đồng thời mang ý nghĩa so sánh nhất (ở bất cứ đâu), vì vậy ta dùng widest.

questions.stem: The Stallmain Corporation's latest survey was intended to ------- employee satisfaction in several key categories.
questions.explanation: Động từ determine (xác định/đo lường) thường được dùng trong các khảo sát để đánh giá mức độ hài lòng của nhân viên.

questions.stem: Garza's Restaurant is ------- decorated with paintings and photographs of southern Mexico.
questions.explanation: Chỗ trống đứng trước tính từ (quá khứ phân từ) decorated, nên cần một trạng từ để bổ nghĩa. Elaborately (một cách tỉ mỉ/trau chuốt).

questions.stem: Mr. Brighton's first ------- at Glynn Engineering was in the materials testing group.
questions.explanation: Sau tính từ sở hữu "first" cần một danh từ. Assignment (nhiệm vụ/công việc được giao) là danh từ phù hợp nhất trong ngữ cảnh công việc.

questions.stem: The installation of new benches throughout Haverford Park will cost ------- €5,000.
questions.explanation: Trạng từ roughly (khoảng/xấp xỉ) thường được dùng trước một con số để chỉ mức chi phí ước tính.

questions.stem: ------- who is unable to attend the quarterly stakeholder meeting is welcome to appoint a representative.
questions.explanation: Anyone đóng vai trò chủ ngữ cho mệnh đề số ít "is unable...". "Those" không chọn được vì đi với động từ số nhiều.

questions.stem: Singer Maria Stanley ------- today that she is scheduling a world tour.
questions.explanation: Câu cần một động từ chính chia theo chủ ngữ số ít "Maria Stanley". Vì hành động thông báo đã xảy ra, thì quá khứ đơn revealed là hợp lý nhất.

questions.stem: Biographer Amber Bowen has been recognized for her distinctive writing -------.
questions.explanation: writing đóng vai trò là một danh từ (noun) hoặc cụ thể hơn là một danh động từ (gerund) hoạt động như một tính từ bổ nghĩa cho 1 danh từ là "style".

questions.stem: The award-winning stationery created by the artists at Paperi Designs is of ------- quality.
questions.explanation: Tính từ exceptional (ngoại lệ/xuất sắc) thường đi kèm với "quality" để chỉ chất lượng hàng hóa cực kỳ tốt.

questions.stem: During the past quarter, ------- all of Renafy Technology's sales came from one region.
questions.explanation: Trạng từ nearly (gần như) bổ nghĩa cho "all" (nearly all: gần như tất cả) để chỉ tỉ lệ phần lớn doanh số đến từ một vùng.

questions.stem: Commercial property insurance covers the ------- associated with repairing or rebuilding a business property after certain events.
questions.explanation: Trong bảo hiểm, expenses (chi phí) là danh từ phù hợp nhất để nói về các khoản tiền liên quan đến việc sửa chữa hoặc xây dựng lại.

questions.stem: The first-aid class usually fills up quickly, so prompt ------- is recommended.
questions.explanation: Cụm từ prompt registration (việc đăng ký nhanh chóng/ngay lập tức) là lời khuyên phổ biến khi một lớp học thường hết chỗ nhanh.

questions.stem: Manufacturing all its products in-house allows Long Bridge Steel Corp. to ------- every aspect of the production process.
questions.explanation: Việc tự sản xuất tại xưởng (in-house) giúp công ty có thể control (kiểm soát) mọi khía cạnh của quy trình sản xuất.

questions.stem: ------- its use on home-cooking shows, consumer demand for Silvershine Cookware has doubled.
questions.explanation: Giới từ Because of (Bởi vì) đứng trước cụm danh từ để chỉ nguyên nhân dẫn đến việc nhu cầu tiêu dùng tăng gấp đôi.

questions.stem: Artists at Cavin Graphics work ------- with clients through all stages of the design process to ensure satisfaction.
questions.explanation: Trạng từ collaboratively (một cách hợp tác) bổ nghĩa cho động từ "work", chỉ cách thức làm việc giữa nghệ sĩ và khách hàng.

questions.stem: Brile Construction's contract for the mall development project has finally been ------- by the city supervisor.
questions.explanation: Cấu trúc bị động: "contract... has been verified" (hợp đồng đã được xác thực). Verified là động từ phù hợp nhất để chỉ việc phê duyệt chính thức.

questions.stem: ------- 4,000 Urlvac trash removal systems are in use in the eastern region.
questions.explanation: Trạng từ Almost (Gần như) đứng trước một con số (4,000) để chỉ số lượng xấp xỉ nhưng chưa tới mức đó.

questions.stem: The conference schedule will be posted online ------- mailed to attendees.
questions.explanation: Cấu trúc rather than (thay vì) được dùng để chỉ sự lựa chọn: đăng trực tuyến thay vì gửi qua thư.
Từ "This" ám chỉ đến "bicycle racks" (giá để xe đạp) đã được nhắc ở câu trước. Trong ngữ cảnh này, "equipment" (thiết bị) là danh từ chung phù hợp nhất để gọi các giá treo được lắp đặt này.

options.text: No additional fee will be charged for bringing a bicycle.
Always make sure to exit at the correct bus stop.
Special lanes for bicycles are now found on most highways.

questions.explanation: Câu tiếp theo bắt đầu bằng "Please note, however..." (Tuy nhiên, xin lưu ý...) nói về việc hạn chế xe đạp điện. Vì vậy, câu trước đó thường nói về lợi ích hoặc quy định chung của chương trình. Đáp án A (không tính phí) phù hợp với từ "complimentary" ở câu sau.
